content:
GOAL: orient before proposing a mechanism.
READ: workspace listing and any round artefacts available under the ideation_3 working directory.
OBSERVED: (to fill)
WHERE: workspace root
REASONING: the round context says three partition-moving mechanisms all lost, so I need to see the actual Stage2 code and the frozen baseline before choosing a coupling site.
OPEN: baseline SID/quantizer code path, Stage2 objective, available behaviour splits.

GOAL: pick the round-four mechanism.
READ: brief only (fs denied).
OBSERVED: all three prior losses moved the whole partition; loss grows with distance from plain text geometry. So choose shape (A) with a hard 5% margin-shell guard: >=95% of level-1 assignments stay identical, encoder and codebooks untouched.
WHERE: full answer in the reply (SHELL-CURV-RQ).
REASONING: behaviour enters as a TIE-BREAK only, ranked by Poincare distance (c=1, gauge-fixed) to behaviour code-centroids built from train transitions; curvature acts as a bounded displacement budget, so geometry-off (Euclidean) is a real test. Not prefix merging (5% cap, measured), not input relocation (no encoder/codebook movement), not a fourth argmin level (L=3).
OPEN: whether 5% flips is enough to beat 0.065; the one run must report level-1 agreement and prefix counts against 251/1769/2201. No ablation arm is trained.
ANSWER: IDEA SHELL-CURV-RQ - margin-shell curved behaviour re-assignment, <=5% of items re-tokenised, Poincare tie-break to behaviour centroids; switches behaviour_enabled / geometry=euclidean|poincare exist and both-on is the single trained arm.
